Holiday Channel is a forward-thinking startup focused on creating innovative solutions like Digital Magazines, Marketplace and Streaming Platform to enhance holiday experiences. Immediate opportunity to make an impact on our team, product, and business.

A chance to work with a startup that has over 110K users.

A get-stuff-done and fun and caring culture.

Meaningful work and a strong shared sense of mission.

A remote first working environment with an office in Colorado Springs, CO.

A platform to lead and innovate within a dynamic startup environment, offering substantial opportunities for professional growth and development.

Sponsorship for international students on F-1 OPT ((Optional Practical Training)

We are seeking talented and motivated individuals to join our team for an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies and projects. Collaborate with the development team to design, build, and maintain full-stack web applications using Next.js/React.js, Node.js and Express.js with TypeScript.

Implement responsive user interfaces using Tailwind CSS.

Create engaging animations and interactions with Framer Motion.

Develop and manage PostgreSQL databases.

Assist in integrating APIs and third-party services.

Participate in code reviews and contribute to team discussions on best practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems.

Stay updated with the latest web technologies and tools.

Work on both front-end and back-end features of the application.

Contribute to the planning and design of new software products.

What You'll Have

2+ years of experience working with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).

Proficiency in TypeScript.

Strong understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

Experience with front-end frameworks (Next.js, React.js) and back-end frameworks (Node.js, Express.js).

Familiarity with Tailwind CSS for responsive design.

Experience with Framer Motion for animations.

Knowledge of PostgreSQL and database management.

Understanding of microservice architecture.

Familiarity with RESTful APIs and version control systems (Git).

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Strong communication skills and the ability to contribute ideas in a constructive manner.

Experience in eCommerce development is a plus.

What Helps You Stand Out

Familiarity with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 1,800 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team: 

Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. You'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

 

How you’ll make an impact

Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend and full-stack initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.

Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture and full-stack patterns, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness.

Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality experiences.

Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.

Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.

Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.

Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

 

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.

Full-stack experience designing and building backend services and APIs in a language such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, or Node.js.

Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend or full-stack projects in production.

Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as the frontend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical product surface.

Experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.

Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.

Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.

Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress) and CI/CD workflows.

Hands-on experience leveraging generative AI in product features or internal engineering workflows.

Passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

 

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

jobs.description:
CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

Key Accountabilities:

Help shape technical direction on the Essentials squad — contributing to architecture decisions and unblocking teammates — while staying hands-on in Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, and React

Lead by example in the codebase: write clean, maintainable, refactor-friendly code and elevate quality through thoughtful code review and pairing

Design and optimize back-end systems, APIs, and data flows with a strong focus on performance and reliability, sharing what you learn along the way

Build modern, responsive front-end experiences using React, TypeScript, and CSS, with an eye toward maintainable architecture

Work across relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, etc.), writing efficient SQL and shaping data models that support business growth

Lead projects end-to-end, balancing hands-on development with guiding others to successful delivery, surfacing risks early and communicating trade-offs clearly

Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and QA to translate business needs into sound technical solutions

Embrace AI-assisted engineering: use tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot effectively, contribute to shared prompts and agentic workflows, and help the team learn what works

Identify and prototype opportunities to apply LLMs and automation to engineering and internal workflows, with the guardrails appropriate to healthcare data and regulated billing

Desired Skills and Experience:

At least 7-10 years of full-stack development experience, with Ruby on Rails as a core strength

Experience with React, 5+ years preferred.

Experienced in leading projects end-to-end: from breaking down complex problems to shipping features that drive impact

Passionate about mentoring, from pair programming to guiding architectural decisions, and helping others grow as engineers

Daily, hands-on fluency with AI development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), with sharp judgment about where AI accelerates work and where human review is non-negotiable

Experience, or strong demonstrated interest, in building with LLM APIs: prompt design, evaluation, and safety considerations for sensitive data

Highly organized with superb attention to detail

Strong project management skills: comfortable with planning, estimation, and scoping

Proven ability to work in an ever-changing environment, ability to connect the dots and make decisions on your own feet

Ability to produce quality materials within tight timeframes and simultaneously manage several projects

Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing

Exercise sound judgment and work successfully with all employee levels, regardless of background and perspectives

Lauderdale, FL; Holmdel, NJ; and Verona, Italy, we foster a workplace where top talent can thrive and make a real difference in the lives of those we serve.

Our team members also enjoy hybrid work schedules, career development support, wellness programs, and opportunities to give back through CR Cares™, our community engagement initiative.

Be part of a market leader driving the future of care. Explore opportunities at centralreach.com/careers.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Data Integration

In Brief

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.

Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.

Who We Are

Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.

Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.

What you’ll do

You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform to generate real-time lifesaving clinical insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' technical teams, you'll turn fragmented data into immediate, actionable clinical insights that empower care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.

Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a lab result isn't reaching the Bayesian platform for a patient, you have thirty minutes and the client's full attention to trace it from the inbound HL7 message through parsing, mapping, and ingestion, and tell them what happened.

Responsibilities

Data Integration & Ingestion: Partner with the client's technical teams to design and implement the data integration interface and ingestion pipelines that feed the Bayesian platform with real-time clinical data, powering insights that improve patient outcomes.

Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests at the data layer, and work directly with client technical teams during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.

Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring build and configuration for the data interface, ingestion, and mapping are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any data integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.

Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the data integration workstream with the overall integration effort.

Minimum qualifications

BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

3+ years building and deploying data pipelines to production, including integration with external APIs (Python preferred)

Strong ability to investigate and resolve data correctness problem end-to-end, across services, storage, and external data sources.

Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment

Experience writing automated integration tests for production systems

Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Project/Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.

Preferred qualifications

Experience with health data, integration with Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems, and Health IT interoperability standards such as HL7v2 and FHIR.

Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues

Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.

Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

Bayesian Health provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
